_nguon: Cau truc hoa tu source-skills/thanso-hoc/references/y-nghia-so.md (chu du an tu viet). KHONG bia them.
_triet_ly: Cach B: moi luan giai truy ve nguon. Moi so BAT BUOC co mat_toi + phan_chung (chong Barnum). Neu KB khong co thi im lang.

sources.mo_ta: Than so hoc Pythagoras hien dai, My 1905-1965 (L. Dow Balliett, Juno Jordan).
sources.luu_y: Cac mo ta khac nhau tuy tac gia — khong co ban chuan. Dung nhu de tai tham khao, khong nhu su that.

schools.ten: Pythagoras (ban Viet, bien soan boi chu du an)

1.tu_khoa: Khoi dau, doc lap, dan dat
1.mat_toi: Ap dat, kho hop tac, so bi lu mo
1.phan_chung: Co bao nhieu lan ban chu dong nhuong quyen quyet dinh ma khong thay kho chiu?

2.tu_khoa: Hop tac, nhay cam, hoa giai
2.mat_toi: Ne xung dot den muc de viec mung mu
2.phan_chung: Lan gan nhat ban noi 'khong' thang, khong giai thich dai dong?

3.tu_khoa: Dien dat, sang tao, giao tiep
3.mat_toi: Tan man, bo giua, noi nhieu hon lam
3.phan_chung: Ban co du an nao theo toi cung du da het hung?

4.tu_khoa: Nen tang, ky luat, xay dung
4.mat_toi: Cung nhac, so doi, cay ma khong hoi de lam gi
4.phan_chung: Lan gan nhat ban pha bo mot he thong minh da dung?

5.tu_khoa: Tu do, bien dong, trai nghiem
5.mat_toi: Boc, thieu ben, doi huong khi vua kho
5.phan_chung: Ban da o dau du lau de thay hau qua dai han cua viec minh lam?

6.tu_khoa: Trach nhiem, cham soc, gia dinh
6.mat_toi: Kiem soat duoi vo quan tam, tu hy sinh roi oan
6.phan_chung: Ban co de nguoi khac tu xu ly viec cua ho ma khong can vao?

7.tu_khoa: Phan tich, chieu sau, doc lap tu tuong
7.mat_toi: Xa cach, hoai nghi thanh luoi tin, phan tich thay hanh dong
7.phan_chung: Lan gan nhat ban quyet ma chua du du lieu, va on voi dieu do?

8.tu_khoa: Quyen luc, to chuc, vat chat
8.mat_toi: Do nguoi bang ket qua, kho nghi, lan gia tri voi gia ca
8.phan_chung: Ban co viec gi lam ma khong tinh toi loi ich?

9.tu_khoa: Bao dung, ly tuong, cho di
9.mat_toi: Cuu nguoi de tranh nhin minh, ky vong roi that vong
9.phan_chung: Ban co nhan giup do ma khong thay mac no?

11.tu_khoa: Truc giac, cam nhan, truyen cam hung
11.mat_toi: Lo lang nen, ly tuong qua da, de kiet
11.phan_chung: Truc giac cua ban da sai lan nao, va ban co ghi lai khong?

22.tu_khoa: Kien tao lon, bien tam nhin thanh he thong
22.mat_toi: Ganh qua suc, hoan vi 'chua du lon'
22.phan_chung: Ban da hoan thanh cai gi nho, gan day?

33.mat_toi: Hoa tan ban than vao vai tro
33.phan_chung: Ban muon gi cho rieng minh, khong lien quan toi ai?

duong_doi.khung: manh chu dao cua ca doi — huong di va bai hoc trung tam

su_menh.khung: muc tieu can vun dap, cai ban huong toi

linh_hon.khung: dong luc ben trong, dieu ban thuc su mong muon

nhan_cach.khung: ve ngoai nguoi khac cam nhan truoc khi hieu ban
